What do the fields mean? How does the Applicator work?
Process conditions: describe what you measure and in which conditions. The Applicator ranks every technology that can do it (best match first) and shows why the others are not suitable.
Sizing (optional): add flow rate, tank height or pipe size and each suitable technology is sized: pipe size, probe length, sensor range or insertion length.
Inquiry: add the result to your inquiry list. Our engineers check it and confirm the exact model and order code.
What you want to measure: flow (how much passes through a pipe), level (how full a tank or silo is), pressure, temperature or analysis (pH, conductivity, gas composition …).

What is in the pipe or tank: liquid (water, oil, chemicals), gas, steam, slurry (liquid with solids, e.g. mud or pulp) or bulk solid (powder, grain, sand). It rules out technologies that cannot handle it.
The highest temperature of the medium during operation (not the ambient air). Technologies whose limit is too low are excluded.
The highest operating pressure in the pipe or tank (gauge, i.e. above atmospheric). For pressure measurement this value is also used to choose the sensor range.

Only for flow of liquids: how well the liquid conducts electricity. Electromagnetic flowmeters need at least 5 µS/cm. Tap water ≈ 500, demineralised water < 1, oils ≈ 0. Leave it empty if you don't know.
Tick it if the instrument is installed where explosive gas or dust can occur (refineries, gas plants, offshore). Only technologies with ATEX / IECEx versions are shown.
Tick it for food, beverage or pharma processes that need cleanable, 3-A / EHEDG-certified designs.
Your normal operating flow rate. Used to calculate the flow velocity and the best pipe size (DN) for each flowmeter type.
The nominal size (DN) of the pipe where the meter goes. We tell you if the meter can have the same size or needs reducers.
Height of the tank or silo from the bottom to the top. Gives the measuring range, probe length or sensor range.
Height of the mounting nozzle on top of the tank (the pipe stub the instrument is screwed or flanged onto). Typically 0.1–0.3 m.
Only for hydrostatic level: how heavy the liquid is. Water = 1000, diesel ≈ 840, sulphuric acid ≈ 1830.
Only for DP transmitters (filter monitoring, flow via orifice, level in closed tanks): the largest pressure difference between the two sides.
The pipe the sensor is mounted in. Gives the insertion length of the thermometer, or the right assembly (bypass, inline, retractable) for analysis sensors.
Optional, for temperature: how fast the medium flows. At high velocity the thermowell needs a strength calculation.
For analysis: tick it if the sensor must be taken out for cleaning or calibration without stopping the process.
Don't know a value? Leave it empty: you still get the technology ranking, and our engineers ask for the missing data.

We source instrumentation and automation from Emerson, Endress+Hauser, Honeywell, ABB, Siemens, VEGA, WIKA, Fuji Electric, Pepperl+Fuchs and Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Automation, and we recommend the brand that fits your application best.
Can you help select the right instrument?
Yes. Use the VIS Applicator for a first technology recommendation and flow sizing, then send us the result. Our engineers will confirm materials, approvals and the order code.
Do you supply hazardous area (Ex) and SIL-rated devices?
Yes. Most of our product families are available with ATEX/IECEx approvals and SIL2/SIL3 certification for safety instrumented systems.
Do you offer installation, calibration and service in Azerbaijan?
Our local team provides commissioning, on-site calibration, repair coordination, spare parts and training across Azerbaijan.
Send us the nameplate data or order code of the existing device. We will propose a form-fit-function replacement from the current portfolios.
What do you need to quote a valve?

A datasheet with at least the line size, fluid name, inlet pressure, outlet pressure, temperature, actuation type (electric or pneumatic) and whether sand is present. When you add a valve or actuator to your inquiry list, the contact form asks for exactly these values.
Can you quote against our ICSS or DCS specification?

Yes. Send us your Integrated Control and Safety System (ICSS) specification with your inquiry. Our engineers map its requirements to the matching Emerson products: DeltaV and DeltaV SIS, Electronic Marshalling, AMS asset management, WirelessHART and FIELDVUE valve controllers.
How do I get a quotation?
Add products to your inquiry list, or describe your project in the contact form. Including the tag list, process conditions and required approvals speeds up the quotation.
Needed for every valve and actuator in your inquiry. One datasheet per line item; if units run in different conditions, describe them in your project requirements.

Typical requirements of an Integrated Control and Safety System (ICSS) specification, a basic process control system (BPCS) and a safety instrumented system (SIS) on one platform, and the Emerson products that meet them.

One engineering and operating environment for process control and safety, kept separate according to IEC 61511. The SIS performs ESD, BMS, F&G and HIPPS functions up to SIL 3 (TÜV certified) and still works after one critical failure.

Every I/O channel can be assigned to any controller or logic solver without moving wires or external marshalling. Zone 2 mounting, intrinsically safe barriers inside the I/O, redundant cards and power.
HART 7 with device diagnostics passed through to asset management (no HART multiplexers), FOUNDATION fieldbus (HIST 2.1), PROFIBUS DP, DeviceNet and AS-i.
WirelessHART with AES-128 encryption, redundant gateways, field devices on encapsulated battery modules, and wireless devices shown in the BPCS like wired ones.
Device diagnostics, configuration, calibration management and prioritised maintenance for BPCS and SIS devices in the same platform, with every activity documented automatically.
SIS valves and partial stroke testing
All SIS shutdown valve positioners are HART enabled. Partial stroke tests are scheduled in the SIS, and the digital valve position is used for command-disagree alarms.
Machinery monitoring configured with the ICSS engineering tools and integrated in asset management, without gateway devices.
Simulation of up to 8 controllers using the unchanged control configuration, with process models and operator training reports.
ISA Secure (SSA Level 1) certified architecture, hardened network configuration, perimeter protection, network partitions and account management.
A lifecycle support plan for the site, remote health monitoring with automatic notifications, and KPI dashboards for BPCS and SIS.

Rosemount is Emerson's measurement brand for pressure, temperature, level, flow and analysis. It covers the 3051 / 3051S / 2051 pressure transmitters, the 5408 and 5300 radar level transmitters, the 644 and 3144P temperature transmitters, 8700 magnetic and 8800 vortex flowmeters, liquid and gas analyzers, and the Rosemount Wireless range. Typical strengths are long-term stability, extensive approvals (ATEX, IECEx, SIL 2/3) and HART, FOUNDATION Fieldbus or WirelessHART communication.

Micro Motion invented the Coriolis flowmeter and is Emerson's brand for direct mass flow and density measurement. The ELITE, F-Series, G-Series, H-Series (hygienic) and T-Series sensors are combined with 1700/2700, 4200 or 5700 transmitters. They measure mass flow, density and temperature in one device, with custody-transfer approvals for oil, gas and LNG.

Flexim (part of Emerson) builds clamp-on ultrasonic flowmeters (FLUXUS) and process refractometers (PIOX). The transducers are mounted on the outside of the pipe, so there is no pressure loss, no wetted parts and no process shutdown for installation. Typical uses are large water lines, hot oils, aggressive chemicals, steam and compressed air.

Roxar (Emerson) supplies instrumentation for oil and gas production: multiphase and wet-gas flowmeters, sand and pig detection, corrosion and erosion monitoring, and downhole / subsea pressure and temperature sensors for wellhead and reservoir monitoring.
Paine (Emerson) makes rugged pressure and temperature transducers for harsh environments: aerospace, defence, subsea and high-pressure industrial applications.
Spectrex (Emerson) makes optical flame detectors (IR3, UV/IR) and open-path gas detection for refineries, offshore platforms, tank farms and other hazardous areas.
Net Safety (Emerson) supplies fixed gas detection: combustible and toxic gas sensors and transmitters, used for personnel and plant safety in oil and gas facilities.
Damcos (Emerson) supplies valve remote-control systems, hydraulic actuators and tank monitoring for ships and offshore units.
Leveldatic (Emerson) builds rugged mechanical level switches and indicators for tanks and silos.

Fisher is Emerson's control valve brand: globe, rotary and butterfly control valves, actuators, FIELDVUE digital valve controllers (DVC6200) and pressure regulators. Fisher valves are used for flow, pressure and level control loops in almost every process industry.
Keystone (Emerson) makes butterfly valves, from resilient-seated valves for water and HVAC to high-performance (K-LOK) and triple-offset valves for process and steam service.
Kunkle (Emerson) supplies spring-loaded safety and relief valves for steam, air, gas and liquid service, sized to ASME Section I and VIII.
Anderson Greenwood (Emerson) makes pilot-operated and spring-loaded pressure relief valves, and tank vents for storage tanks.
Crosby (Emerson) builds spring-loaded pressure relief valves for refining, chemical and power applications.
Sempell (Emerson) builds high-pressure, high-temperature valves for power plants: safety valves, check valves and gate valves for main steam and feedwater.
Yarway (Emerson) supplies steam conditioning, desuperheaters, bypass valves and steam traps for power and industrial steam systems.
Vanessa (Emerson) makes triple-offset rotary valves with zero leakage for critical isolation, high temperatures and cryogenic service.
Bettis (Emerson) builds pneumatic, hydraulic and electric valve actuators, including scotch-yoke actuators for large quarter-turn valves and emergency shutdown (ESD) duty.
KTM (Emerson) makes trunnion-mounted and floating ball valves for oil, gas and process isolation.
Enardo (Emerson) supplies tank vents, flame arrestors and vapour control equipment for storage tanks.
Tartarini (Emerson) builds gas pressure regulators for gas distribution networks and industrial supply.

DeltaV is Emerson's distributed control system with the integrated DeltaV SIS safety system. Controllers, Electronic Marshalling (CHARMs), workstations, batch, historian and simulation share one engineering environment, and AMS Device Manager is embedded for device diagnostics.

AMS is Emerson's asset management portfolio: AMS Device Manager for HART, FOUNDATION fieldbus and wireless field devices and valves, and AMS machinery monitoring (AMS 6500 ATG) for turbines, compressors and pumps.
Emerson product for process automation, typically part of a complete measurement or control solution (wireless gateways, power modules, actuators, accessories).

t-mass is Endress+Hauser's thermal mass flowmeter line for gases: compressed air, nitrogen, CO2, natural gas and biogas. It measures mass flow directly, with no pressure or temperature compensation and a very high turndown.
Soliwave is Endress+Hauser's microwave barrier for non-contact point level detection and object detection in bulk solids, chutes and conveyors, even through non-metallic walls.
Fieldgate devices are Endress+Hauser gateways that send measured values from field instruments to the cloud or a control system (remote monitoring of tanks, wells and stations).
Solitrend is Endress+Hauser's microwave moisture measurement for bulk solids such as sand, grain and gravel.
Tankvision is Endress+Hauser's tank inventory system for tank farms: it collects level, temperature and density from the tank gauges and calculates the volume and mass in each tank.
Proservo is Endress+Hauser's servo tank gauge for high-accuracy level, interface and density measurement in storage tanks (custody transfer and inventory control).

Gammapilot is Endress+Hauser's radiometric (gamma) transmitter for level, point level, density and interface, measured non-contact from outside the vessel. It is used for extreme conditions: high pressure, high temperature, toxic or abrasive media.
Silopilot is Endress+Hauser's electromechanical level system (plumb-bob) for very dusty silos and bulk solids.
Solimotion is Endress+Hauser's motion detector (rotation and standstill monitoring) for conveyors and rotating equipment.
Tank Side Monitor is Endress+Hauser's field display and data concentrator mounted at the tank, used with tank gauging systems.
Flowfit is Endress+Hauser's flow-through assembly for liquid analysis sensors, installed in a bypass or sample line.
Dipfit is Endress+Hauser's immersion assembly for analysis sensors in open basins and channels.
Teqwave is Endress+Hauser's acoustic-wave sensor for concentration and density of liquids, e.g. sugar, alcohol and chemical concentrations.
Flow-X is a flow computer for custody transfer of oil and gas, used with Coriolis, ultrasonic and turbine meters.
Flowphant is Endress+Hauser's compact flow switch for monitoring cooling water and lubrication circuits.
FlexView is a field display for showing measured values close to the process.
Ecograph is Endress+Hauser's compact paperless data recorder for recording and displaying process values.
Memograph is Endress+Hauser's advanced paperless data manager: it records, monitors and evaluates process values, with mathematics and secure data storage.
Minilog is a compact data logger for recording measured values at remote locations.
Part of the safety instrumented system (SIS): it runs the safety functions (ESD, BMS, F&G, HIPPS) independently of process control, certified to IEC 61508 / IEC 61511.
Part of the basic process control system (BPCS): controllers, I/O and workstations that run the plant's control loops, alarms and operator graphics.
Asset management for an integrated control and safety system: it uses the diagnostics of intelligent field devices and machines to plan maintenance before a failure stops the process.
Simulation software that runs the real control configuration against a process model, for testing before start-up and for operator training.
An application of the DeltaV control system, configured in the same engineering environment as the control strategies.
Security for the control network: segmentation, hardened devices and protection against unauthorised access, following ISA/IEC 62443.

An online analyzer that measures the parameter automatically in a sample stream, using a wet-chemistry or photometric method with automatic calibration and cleaning. It replaces manual laboratory sampling and gives a continuous value for process control and environmental reporting.
An optical sensor or analyzer that measures organic load or nutrients (SAC, COD, TOC, nitrate) directly in the medium, without reagents. Used for wastewater treatment control and effluent monitoring.
Turbidity measurement: an optical sensor measures light scattered by suspended solids. Used for drinking water, filtration control, wastewater and sludge.

Disinfection measurement: amperometric sensors for free chlorine, total chlorine, chlorine dioxide or ozone. Used to control dosing in drinking water, swimming pools, cooling water and food processing.
An automatic water sampler that takes time- or flow-proportional samples for laboratory analysis, as required for wastewater discharge permits.
Sample preparation (filtration) for online analyzers, so that the analyzer receives a clean, particle-free sample.
An accessory for liquid analysis: it holds, connects or services the sensors and is ordered together with the matching sensor and transmitter.

Radiometric measurement: a gamma source and a detector mounted outside the vessel measure level, density or interface without any contact with the medium. Licensing and handling of the source are arranged with our engineers.
Part of a tank gauging system for storage tanks: level, temperature and density are combined for inventory and custody-transfer calculations.
An oil leak detector that detects oil on water (e.g. in pump pits, drains and tank bunds) and raises an alarm.
A non-contact microwave barrier for point level and presence detection in bulk solids.
Moisture measurement in bulk solids, using microwaves.
Thermal mass flow measurement for gases: a heated sensor is cooled by the gas flow, and the energy needed gives the mass flow directly.
A compact flow switch for monitoring that a medium is flowing (cooling water, lubrication, pump protection).
An energy manager that calculates heat, steam, gas and water energy flows from flow, pressure and temperature signals.
A handheld device configurator for setting up and diagnosing HART, PROFIBUS and FOUNDATION Fieldbus instruments in the field.
A system component for the measuring loop: power supply, signal isolation, Ex barrier, surge protection, display or data recording.
A complete measurement and control system for custody transfer, for example LNG bunkering or meter proving.
A pressure relief device that protects equipment against overpressure. Sizing to API 520 / ASME is done by our engineers from your relief case.
A butterfly valve for isolation or throttling, lighter and more compact than a ball or gate valve of the same size.
A ball valve for tight shut-off in oil, gas and process lines.
A control valve that throttles flow, pressure or level in a control loop. Valve sizing (Cv) and actuator selection are done by our engineers.
A valve actuator that opens and closes the valve (pneumatic, hydraulic or electric), sized to the valve torque and the required stroke time.
A valve positioner / digital valve controller that sets the valve position from the 4–20 mA signal and provides valve diagnostics.
A self-operated pressure regulator that keeps the downstream pressure constant without an external power supply.
An optical flame detector for fast, false-alarm-resistant fire detection in hazardous areas.
Fixed gas detection for combustible or toxic gases, used for personnel and plant safety.
Integrity monitoring for pipelines and wells: corrosion, erosion, sand or pig detection, so problems are found before they cause damage or downtime.
Part of a WirelessHART network: devices send measured values over a self-organising wireless mesh, which saves cabling at remote or rotating points.
Flow measurement for liquids, gases and steam: volume or mass flow for process control, dosing, energy balancing and custody transfer.
Level measurement in tanks, silos and open channels: continuous level for inventory and control, and point level switches for overfill and dry-run protection.
Pressure measurement: gauge, absolute and differential pressure for process control, filter monitoring, level and flow (via differential pressure).
Temperature measurement with RTD or thermocouple sensors, thermowells and transmitters, from cryogenic to furnace temperatures.
Liquid analysis: pH, conductivity, oxygen, disinfection, turbidity and nutrients, for water treatment, chemical and food processes.
Gas analysis and gas / flame detection: process gas composition, combustion control, emissions monitoring and plant safety.
Valves and actuators: control valves, isolation valves, pressure relief, regulators and actuators, the final control element of every control loop.
Control and safety systems for an integrated control and safety system (ICSS): process control (BPCS), safety instrumented system (SIS), I/O, asset management, simulation and network security.

Safety instrumented system (SIS), TÜV certified up to SIL 3
Flexible assignment I/O for the BPCS
Digital bus I/O: FOUNDATION fieldbus H1, HART, PROFIBUS DP, DeviceNet, AS-i
Process simulation and operator training (medium to high fidelity)
HART digital valve controller for SIS valves

Basic process control system (BPCS) of an ICSS: redundant controllers, operator and engineering workstations, alarm management, graphics and reports in one engineering environment, with the safety system and asset management integrated but kept separate.

Logic solver for ESD, BMS, F&G and HIPPS functions, designed to IEC 61508 / IEC 61511. Integrated sequence-of-events recording, partial stroke test scheduling for SIS valves and HART diagnostics of field devices without HART multiplexers.

Single-channel I/O (CHARMs) that can be assigned to any controller without re-wiring and without separate marshalling cabinets. Redundant I/O cards and power, Zone 2 installation, intrinsically safe and non-IS channel types (AI/AO with HART, DI, DO, RTD, thermocouple).
Safety I/O for DeltaV SIS with Electronic Marshalling: every channel can be assigned to a logic solver without moving wires, and input signals are shared over the redundant safety network.

Conventional and digital bus I/O for DeltaV: HART 7 analog cards with pass-through of device diagnostics to asset management, FOUNDATION fieldbus H1 cards, and interfaces for PROFIBUS DP, DeviceNet and AS-i.

Asset management embedded in the BPCS and SIS: configure and commission HART, FOUNDATION fieldbus and wireless devices, monitor alerts, run valve diagnostics and partial stroke tests, manage calibrations and document every change automatically.

Protection and prediction monitoring for rotating machinery (turbines, compressors, pumps), configured with the DeltaV engineering tools and integrated in the asset management software without gateways.
Runs the unchanged DeltaV control configuration on a workstation, emulating controllers and I/O, for checkout, testing and operator training.
Process models from tie-back to high fidelity that connect to the DeltaV I/O bus, with training scenarios, malfunctions and session reports of operator actions.
ISA-88 batch execution, recipe and campaign management with a batch historian and operator interface, integrated in DeltaV.
Real-time and historical collection of DeltaV and SIS data for trends, reports and SIS events, enabled per module in the standard configuration.
Pre-hardened network switches and a firewall / intrusion prevention device for the DeltaV control network, supporting network partitioning and perimeter protection.

HART positioner for emergency shutdown and other safety valves: partial stroke testing scheduled from the SIS, digital valve position for command-disagree alarms, and valve diagnostics in AMS Device Manager.
Intelligent positioner for control valves with online diagnostics over HART or FOUNDATION fieldbus, so control valve performance degradation is detected by the asset management system.
